Narration_Phrase: Twelve shield warriors held the throat of the lift.
Visual_Subject: Wide establishing down hoist shaft throat. 10s solitary music intro, then 12 heavy shield warriors braced across stone bottleneck with interlocking tower shields.
Motion_Type: Slow cinematic push-in through dust motes; foreground stanchions drift past locked shield wall.
Sound_Cues: Solitary atmospheric strings (0-6.5s) / Heavy downbeat (6.5s) / Low drone

Narration_Phrase: Three hundred civilians jammed knee to knee in the cage, backs pressed to the grating, boots in scum water, breath sour with coal dust and grease.
Visual_Subject: Interior hoist cage. Terrified families packed knee-to-knee against rusted iron mesh. Water dripping onto boots; breath vapor condensing on cold metal ribs.
Motion_Type: Slow vertical tilt tracking cage descent; wire grating creates vertical parallax over dark stone.
Sound_Cues: Rattle of descending guide rails / water drips / hollow breathing

Narration_Phrase: The men coming down the gallery, they weren't soldiers, they were The Welded, condemned miners bolted into hydraulic frames, jawbones pinned with rivets, eyelids stitched open on iron wire...
Visual_Subject: Silhouettes emerging from sulfur-lit gallery tunnel. Condemned miners mechanically bolted into crude hydraulic exoskeletons with riveted jaw plates and wire-stitched eyelids.
Motion_Type: Low-angle lateral tracking shot; foreground steam plumes and heavy hydraulic limbs drifting past.
Evidence_Token: Riveted jaw pins & hydraulic frame joints

Narration_Phrase: ...ribs capped in plate, arms driven by steam cams that never rested.
Visual_Subject: Macro detail on Welded mechanical limb assembly. High-pressure steam cam cycling rapidly, spitting oil across iron-plated ribs as breaker bit rises.
Motion_Type: Macro push-in with rack focus from piston rod to relentless iron breaker fist.

Narration_Phrase: Every time the lift came back for more, an iron bell struck.
Visual_Subject: FIRST BELL TOLL. Massive cast-iron lift clapper strikes the rim of the bell housing as the empty cage rebounds upward.
Motion_Type: Snap-zoom on clapper impact; rust flakes and mortar dust burst outward in 3D parallax.
Sound_Cues: Heavy iron bell strike 1 (t=71.28s) / Subterranean stone reverberation

Narration_Phrase: Each bell meant another line had failed above. At the third bell, pressure main burst in the ceiling, spitting boiling mist through the beams, slicking the walls white.
Visual_Subject: THIRD BELL TOLL. High-pressure steam main fractures along vault ceiling. Boiling white vapor erupts into the line of warriors, obscuring silhouettes.
Motion_Type: Upward camera crane; boiling vapor sweeps across foreground while warriors struggle in background.
Sound_Cues: Iron bell strike 3 (t=84.66s) / High-pressure steam shriek

Narration_Phrase: At the fifth, the haul cable tore free and lashed across the shaft, took six warriors at once...
Visual_Subject: FIFTH BELL TOLL. Multi-strand steel haul cable shears under tension, whipping diagonally across the shaft bottleneck in a lethal horizontal arc.
Motion_Type: High-speed motion blur horizontal whip pan following cable shockwave.
Sound_Cues: Iron bell strike 5 (t=104.58s) / Steel cable snap twang

Narration_Phrase: ...armor split, shields knocked loose, bodies folded into the winch frame.
Visual_Subject: Aftermath of cable lash. Shattered tower shields strewn across wet stone, armor crushed inward, warriors folded into the turning teeth of the hoist winch.
Motion_Type: Slow downward diagonal drift over motionless bodies and turning gears.
Sound_Cues: Low mechanical thrum of uninterrupted winch / creaking iron
Evidence_Token: Buckled armor flanges & crushed shield rims

Narration_Phrase: By the seventh bell, dead men were still operating their harnesses, industrial shield hooks locked under the body's weight...
Visual_Subject: SEVENTH BELL TOLL. Three dead warriors stand rigid in the gallery opening. Lifeless body weight keeps their heavy tower shields anchored upright in the floor slots.
Motion_Type: Slow eerie horizontal parallax pan past unblinking visors and locked shield wall.
Sound_Cues: Iron bell strike 7 (t=127.66s) / Creaking floor hooks
Evidence_Token: Locked harness hooks under static tension

Narration_Phrase: ...and The Welded kept hammering at their corpses, steel fists ringing off dented helms.
Visual_Subject: The Welded relentlessly beating against the immovable dead shield wall, hydraulic fists and breaker bits sparking against cold dented armor plates.
Motion_Type: Camera shake on rhythmic impacts; orange sparks showering toward camera lens.
Sound_Cues: Sparks / heavy sledge impacts ringing off steel
Evidence_Token: Dented helmet crowns & fractured breaker teeth

Narration_Phrase: On the final run, the hoist jammed. The last warrior hauled up his pneumatic hammer, stepped out of the cage, drove the steel head into the drive teeth so the safety doors could steal shut.
Visual_Subject: The hoist cage halts crooked in guide rails. The sole surviving warrior steps onto the carriage, swings his heavy pneumatic hammer, and wedges the hardened head into the drive spur teeth.
Motion_Type: Dramatic low-angle push-in on hero warrior; sparks erupt as teeth bind, doors slam shut.
Sound_Cues: Heavy gear crunch / mechanical latch slam (t=156.32s)
Evidence_Token: Lodged hammer shaft in drive gear teeth

Narration_Phrase: The eleventh bell rang from the shaft below, a hollow thrum that echoed the last breath of those still trapped.
Visual_Subject: ELEVENTH BELL TOLL. Endless pitch-black vertical abyss looking down into the deep mine shaft. A single distant bell toll reverberates through dripping stone.
Motion_Type: Slow infinite vertical camera fall into pitch darkness; faint dust motes drifting upward.
Sound_Cues: Iron bell 11 climactic toll (t=161.82s) / 8s cavern decay
Evidence_Token: Empty shaft throat & distant water drip

Narration_Phrase: The council later put a bronze plaque over the rusted throat of the lift...
Visual_Subject: Centuries later. Rusted, silent hoist throat encrusted with orange corrosion and calcite drips. An ornate, polished bronze Council plaque is bolted over the corroded frame.
Motion_Type: Slow macro push across embossed Council lettering, contrasting pristine bronze with oxidized iron rot.
Sound_Cues: Subtle cold wind whistling through abandoned shaft
Evidence_Token: Gilded Council plaque over rusted stanchions

Narration_Phrase: ...called it a monument. In truth, it was just a repair that they never completed. [Outro Score & Title]
Visual_Subject: Extreme wide pull-back through desolate subterranean hall. The abandoned hoist stands alone in gloom. Title card rises: THE THULANS: ELEVEN BELLS.
Motion_Type: Slow reverse dolly through ancient cavern arches, fading to black as final bell decay dies out.
Sound_Cues: Final score swell / lone resonant bell overtones fading to absolute silence
Evidence_Token: Corroded hoist monument in cavern void
